lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: You were so confident a while back,

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: and now you're cowering like a mouse.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: You're not apologizing for winning or something stupid like that, are you?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I saw you stacking the gold bars too early,

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: and I was going to tell you.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I wanted to win, so I didn't say anything on purpose.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: If I had told you, you could have won.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: That's precisely why you didn't say anything.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: We're not little kids playing during recess here. You and I both know that.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: If you had made the same mistake, none of us would have said anything either.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: It's not about being understanding. This is just how competition works.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I have to give it to you,

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: you were pretty impressive out there.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: But I was mad at myself.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: I saw how hard you were pushing yourself, but I figured we still had it in the bag since one of you essentially bowed out.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Also, I was overconfident and made a stupid mistake.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Anyway, you did an incredible job out there.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: You're not hurt, are you? I just saw you come from the infirmary.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: We just came to get some vitamins.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: Anyway, I'm looking forward to the finals.

lines.speaker: volume
lines.text: You better win, for my sake. Go out there and be a winner.
Volume offers her fist to Soda.
Soda cautiously bumps her fist against Volume's.
With that, Volume turns and walks away,
and Soda watches her back, speechless.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Dang, we've got a whole bunch of people cheering for us. This is awesome!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: It's not that you hold any animosity towards anyone. It's about wanting to win fair and square.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: It was never about hurting others.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: What was I so afraid of all this time?
Maybe you were afraid of being hated.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Maybe I just didn't want to get hurt.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Hehe, at any rate, I'm at peace with how these things work now.
I'm glad you've come to that realization.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: since the finals are tomorrow, that means today is our last day at Coin Rush.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Darn, that makes me feel sad.
It'd be a bit disappointing to leave this place without having explored it more. Why don't we go explore this place a bit?
All of us head up to the second floor.

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: I'd like a glass of warm strawberry milk.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: One for me, and one for her.

lines.speaker: femaleemployee
lines.text: Two cups of Milk Coffee, got it.

lines.speaker: femaleemployee
lines.text: I'll have those ready for you shortly.
Milk plops down next to Soda.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Why are you acting so scared? Did I do something?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: You have a lot to be sorry about.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: You knew how to play seriously all along, so how come you pulled your punches when you went up against me?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I-I was doing my best when I was facing you too!

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: It's just... at the time, I couldn't stand the idea of having to step on someone in order to progress.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: If you want to protect something,

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: sometimes you have to give up something.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I appreciate you ordering this for me, Milk.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Not too bitter, not too sweet, incredibly smooth.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Anybody who can appreciate a Milk Coffee can't be all that bad.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: I'll be honest with you. I was really struggling with the idea of being bested by you.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: However, seeing you out there today made me change my mind.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: You clearly know how to work hard, and you deserve to win.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Next time, you and I ought to have a proper match together.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: You've got to beat those bunnies.

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: Even if you're pushed to the edge and you feel you've got nothing left to give, you can't give up, you got that?

lines.speaker: milk
lines.text: It was nice having a coffee with you.
It's nice that you two made up.
As touching a display as that was...
I can't help but notice Milk left without paying.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: Didn't they say we could replay the games we've played in the Game Zone?

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I'd love to go and check it out.
All right, let's head to the Game Zone.

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: We had a fun time watching you all compete today.

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Especially you, Soda. You killed it out there.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: It's been a while since we've seen someone work up such a sweat.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Even from a distance, I could feel how passionate you were.

lines.speaker: soda_b
lines.text: I'm not really sure how to respond to all these compliments...

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: I figured you were taking things seriously before this, but you always seemed to be holding back.

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Today was the first time I really felt that you gave it everything you had.

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Such boundless enthusiasm is guaranteed to be a hit amongst viewers.

lines.speaker: folkwang_b
lines.text: Tomorrow is the final match. People are wondering whether 777's winning streak is about to end,

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: I also won the bet I had with Dora and Yan.

lines.speaker: exia_c2
lines.text: Is anyone up for trying to break my winning streak?

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Oh, right! It was my turn.

lines.speaker: rupee_b
lines.text: Actually, while you're all here, do you want to have a try?

lines.speaker: alice_b
lines.text: Sure! Is this the game that we played before?

lines.speaker: exia_c2
lines.text: All right, the kid gloves are coming off for this round.
Seeing Alice and Soda have so much fun with the others
brings a smile to my face.
Soda has gone from crying about having no one to participate with her in the competition,
to being surrounded by friends who support her and lift her up.
Even if we don't end up winning, this entire event will be an incredibly meaningful experience for Soda.
Our last night at Coin Rush ends with shared laughter and comradery.
